verdict.rationale: Rootly ships its own public REST API. It is documented with API keys and roles, a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and a changelog showing endpoints across incidents, status-page events and alert sources, plus an MCP server that exposes incident data and actions. Nothing in the evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, so breadth beyond these areas is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI feature parity, evidence of API coverage for configuration areas like schedules, escalation policies, workflows, retrospectives and AI settings, and independent hands-on corroboration of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Rootly API allows you to create incidents automatically from monitoring tools, CI/CD pipelines, internal services, or any external automation system.
Download the OpenAPI/Swagger specification to explore the Rootly API endpoints or generate client libraries.
